steps: Actual mouse click frames all three dispersed rotated boxes; every real Float32 uploaded box corner fits the clip volume. Source draft and saved bytes are unchanged.
Hidden selected objects and a zero-result filter still frame the complete loaded model. Filtering, selected UUID, inspector and highlighting remain unchanged.
Object focus, whole-scene focus, pointer orbit and author-camera reset cooperate. Reset restores the exact original GPU matrices; all-scene framing preserves the current heading.
An invalid edited source keeps native diagnostics and disables exact source location; whole-scene framing continues on the last valid model without saving or clearing that diagnostic.

A new unsaved model uses its complete new bounds. Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px preserve the entire framing action, source text and scrollable controls; all 24 corners fit each actual resized GPU viewport.
Closing disposes the view. Reopening reads the current unsaved draft and frames it; author files retain their original bytes throughout.
Injected WebGL unavailability disables only view controls, keeps verified declarations and does not change author files.

blockingFindings.finding: All three 390px language images show unexpected white/blurred/editor content within the opaque WebGL canvas. Matrix containment and desktop readPixels success do not establish that the narrow final composed image is correct.
blockingFindings.cause: Undetermined; browser/software compositor, scroll timing or product layout must be isolated before acceptance.
blockingFindings.disposition: Root informed and confirmed the Japanese image; keep current evidence immutable and collect follow-up in a new directory.

personallyViewedScreenshots.observation: The three dispersed boxes and selected outline fit the drawn desktop canvas. Object UUID declarations and all five footer actions are visible.

Chinese controls and all five footer actions fit the viewport, but the canvas upper area contains an unexpected bright blurred rectangle and editor remnants; this is not accepted as a normal opaque scene image.
English heading and footer actions wrap legibly, but the canvas contains a bright blurred region and underlying editor remnants above the rendered boxes.
Japanese actions remain visible in wrapped rows. The canvas upper region is severely contaminated by a large white blurred rectangle and visible editor button remnants.
The blank viewport and explicit WebGL2 fallback accompany readable native object declarations; unavailable drawing controls, including full-scene framing, are disabled.

currentSourceScope: Root is independently investigating the rejected screenshots with new harness/CSS experiments. This review binds the immutable original report and images; it does not pretend their old source SHA values bind the advancing investigation.

changes: Bound each CDP request by 10 seconds and handle actual browser dialogs.

After all unsaved-draft and reopen assertions complete, reset only the disposable editor fixture to its original text; assert dirty=false and original saved bytes before the fresh no-WebGL page navigation.

inputMethod: Actual Input.dispatchMouseEvent button entry and pointer orbit. DOM changes are explicit test setup for source text, language, scrolling and renderer instrumentation.
limitations: This round does not claim a fresh full 3811 application suite or 307 Rust tests.
Recorded real uploaded matrices prove corner clipping checks; they do not substitute for composited screenshot review.
Framing all geometry does not promise a distant tiny object has a visible pixel.
No installed desktop, Android, hardware GPU, new HTTP/test execution or actual-checkout write by this reviewer.
